summary: Backend-only regression for the S20 CRM state-machine refactor (statuses, call journal, passage, to-call 9-group logic, transfo, B2B hors-CRM, store='test' isolation). Ran full pytest suite (--ignore=test_phase1_survey.py per request): 86 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed. Full test_s20_refactor.py (26 tests) passes. Supplemented with direct curl checks against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for admin stats keys, to-call item shape/fields, transfo payload shape, and GET /api/admin/demandes/entreprise rejection. Supervisor backend RUNNING, startup migrations completed with no exceptions in backend.err.log. No real SMS fired (SMS_ENABLED=false, CLIENT_SMS_ENABLED=false). Test leads are flagged is_test=true and only routed to TEST_RECIPIENT_EMAIL. Nothing to fix. Frontend intentionally not tested per request.

minor.issue: FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated (DeprecationWarning in test output). Migrate to lifespan handlers at next refactor. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~2500+ lines) is approaching 'too-large single module' territory — consider splitting admin CRM routes, lead state machine, and notification/email layer into submodules on the next refactor pass. Not a bug, maintainability only.
@app.on_event startup/shutdown handlers are deprecated by FastAPI — move _migrate_refactor_fields_v2 and other startup logic to a lifespan context manager when convenient.

context_for_next_testing_agent: S20 refactor is stable and fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_s20_refactor.py (26 tests). The old /status PATCH route is kept for backward compat (verify in test_call_journal.py). B2B is removed from CRM — GET /api/admin/demandes/entreprise returns 400 'Catégorie invalide' and POST /api/b2b archives to demandes_entreprise without any SMS. Public endpoints accept store='test' (auto flagged is_test=true, Hiboutik sync skipped) but still reject store='beziers' with 400. To-call endpoint returns a FLAT LIST (not a sections dict); each item carries category, section ('maintenant'|'plus_tard'|'a_classer'), group (1-9), label, store_name, call_attempts_count. Frontend AdminPage.jsx is intentionally stale and MUST be refactored in a follow-up session — do not test it until the user confirms.
